name: Grassdash
description: Draw the inner edge of the curve back across an exposed forearm while stepping away from the target.

name: Garnerdrop
description: Swing the blade low and flat so the edge rakes across both shins in a single arc.

name: Turning Inwardbelly
description: Slip the blade tip around the back of a knee and tug to buckle the standing leg.

name: Holding Bowbelly
description: Raise the handle and the back of the blade together to meet a downward blow and turn it aside.

name: Flat Crookspine
description: Thrust only the tip forward from a bent elbow into the gap beside the ribs.

name: Sideways Glean
description: Step back off the line of attack with the blade held across the chest to cover the retreat.

name: Level Harvest
description: Pull the sickle from the belt and finish the same motion as a hooked cut across the target's hand.

name: Hitching Handleknob
description: Snag the inside of the curve over a wrist and yank it toward your body to unbalance the target.

name: Single Hookblade
description: Bring the blade down from overhead as if cutting a thick stalk and strike with the curve's heavy middle.

name: Lowered Sicklegrip
description: Hold the blade flat along the forearm and brace behind it to absorb a glancing blow.

name: Easing Greenedge
description: Slide two quick paces along the target's blind flank while keeping the point low and ready.

name: Reapdrop
description: Flick the blunt back of the blade out from the wrist to slap across the target's cheek and eyes.

name: Garnerwedge
description: Hook the blade behind the target's arm and pull it in close as though gathering a bundle.

name: Blunt Sickletang
description: Cut across at waist height with a flat sideways swing and finish with the wrist turned over.

name: Downward Garner
description: Draw the edge upward along the target's inner thigh and hip line from a low crouch.

name: Angled Reapedge
description: Catch an incoming stick in the curve of the blade and twist the wrist to wrench it away.

name: Tipcurve Hit
description: Drive the butt of the handle into the target's collarbone to check a forward rush.

name: Sideways Tipcurve
description: Drop into a crouch and pivot on the ball of the foot to turn out of the attacker's line.

name: Hitching Sheave
description: Loop the curve around both of the target's wrists as if tying a sheaf and draw them together.

name: Reapblow
description: Advance in steady steps while cutting a wide arc left and right to clear a swath before you.

name: Stiff Reap
description: Pick the tip into a gap in the guard as if pulling a weed and withdraw before it closes.

name: Blunt Crookspine
description: Rap the blunt back of the blade sharply across the knuckles of the target's weapon hand.

name: Stopping Sheave
description: Hook the blade into the crook of an attacker's elbow to stop a punch before it extends.

name: Tight Handleknob
description: Spin the blade in a tight circle before the chest to knock aside a flurry of light strikes.

name: Stepping Glean
description: Hop across uneven ground in short skips with the blade held low so footing never breaks.

name: Gleanlid
description: Drag the curve behind the heel of the target's stepping foot to trip them mid-stride.

name: Stookdrop
description: Grip with the whole hand and chop down with the blade's weight behind a slow turn of the shoulder.

name: Turning Garner
description: Hook the target's sleeve, tug once and release so their balance wavers before the next cut.

name: Reapstrike
description: Lay the thumb along the blade's back for control and stab the tip at a small target.

name: Strawstay
description: Cut downward at a slant across an incoming wrist so the block and the slice are one stroke.

name: Nimble Reap
description: Wheel around a fence post or tree trunk to keep it between your blade and the opponent.

name: Raised Bowbelly
description: Hold the handle in both hands before the body and brace the blade against a heavy push.

name: Wide Harvest
description: Warm the edge with a little qi and pull it through the target's guard in one smooth draw.

name: Stopping Stook
description: Run a thin thread of qi into the hook and hold the target's caught wrist for several heartbeats.

name: Grasswedge
description: Slide the flat of the blade along an incoming weapon, then shave the edge down the haft toward the hand.

name: Quiet Sickletang
description: Push a breath of qi into the legs and shuffle two paces onto the target's open side.

name: Stiff Reapedge
description: Focus qi to the point and prick it through a narrow gap in the guard or between armor plates.

name: Quick Sicklegrip
description: Slash outward across the body in the cutter's rhythm, with qi gathered in the wrist at the finish.

name: Strawhusk
description: Rake the hooked tip along the ankle of a charging opponent and spoil the rhythm of the stride.

name: Bladedash
description: Hold the breath and drop the blade straight down in one chop, qi pooling at the edge on impact.

name: Raised Hookblade
description: Fan the curve of the blade left and right before the face to brush aside thrown pebbles and jabs.

name: Shifting Greenedge
description: Plant the toe, push off the ground with a pulse of qi and glide one long pace backward.

name: Turning Reapedge
description: Hook over the back of the target's hand and press it against their own weapon to pin both.

name: Inwardbelly Stay
description: Flick the blade's back up through loose straw or dust to cloud the opponent's eyes for a moment.

name: Firm Bowbelly
description: Cut backward behind your own hand to catch a pursuer's reaching fingers as you turn away.

name: Fouling Reap
description: Set the hook over the target's shoulder and draw them half a pace forward off their line.

name: Bladedrop
description: Slice backhand across the open front with the toothed edge turned toward the opponent's side.

name: Hookblade Lid
description: Hold the blade low and level as a bar, then rise sharply under a swing to lift it off line.

name: Bladewedge
description: Lay the flat of the blade against your shoulder and lean into a rush so the impact is spread.

name: Grasshit
description: Press the point against a seam and keep steady forward pressure with qi until the gap gives.

name: Snug Inwardbelly
description: Circle the handle under a grabbing hand and twist so the blade's edge frees the wrist.

name: Shifting Sheave
description: Walk the diagonal lines of a field in alternating steps so the target cannot settle a thrust.

name: Sickletang Dash
description: Saw the toothed edge back and forth across a limb with steady qi warming each stroke.

name: Tripping Tipcurve
description: Snag the teeth in the opponent's sleeve or belt and drag them a pace off balance.

name: Settled Greenedge
description: Let an incoming blade slip into a tooth notch and twist the wrist to wrench it sideways.

name: Open Harvest
description: Lunge one pace and hook the curve around the guard to tear across the exposed side.

name: Bladetrot
description: Roll the weight from heel to toe across rough ground and slip aside from a straight charge.

name: Fouling Stook
description: Scrape the teeth down the opponent's armor or shield face to jar their grip and timing.

name: Level Handleknob
description: Bring the inner curve up against the collar to halt a lunge without drawing the cut.

name: Sheavestay
description: Reverse the grip, hook the target's arm and pull them past you as you step through.

name: Sheavebump
description: Tuck the elbow to the ribs and slash a short arc that stays inside the target's reach.

name: Planted Crookspine
description: Slide the free hand up the haft and block a heavy swing against the sturdy wood near the blade.

name: Garnercowl
description: Snap the hooked tip up to chin height to startle the opponent into flinching back.

name: Gleanbump
description: Dart the point into the soft gap beside the belt in one tight snap of the wrist.

name: Quiet Stook
description: Pivot on the lead foot and slip out through the gap behind the opponent's swinging arm.
